title: Installment Change Set
description: Installment-level actions for one refine_proposals request (media_buy.installment_refinement). A tuple cannot be an object key, so this is a list rather than a map like core/product-change-map.json. Entries MUST be unique by (product_id, installment_ref); a seller that receives a repeated or contradictory pair rejects the request at task level with INVALID_REQUEST. Buyers SHOULD order entries by the JCS bytes of (product_id, installment_ref) so a rebuilt retry hashes to the same idempotency payload, and sellers MUST NOT make the result depend on order. For each product P the entries name, the selected set is P's installments with every omit removed and every include added. A returned draft satisfies P's entries when it purchases exactly one product whose installments equal the selected set: P itself, or a product the seller offers for that selection in place of P.
